scripts.build: npm run build -w opik-genui && npm run build -w dev-host
scripts.build:python: npm run build -w opik-genui && cd python && rm -rf dist && uv build
scripts.check: npm run smoke -w opik-genui && npm run check -w dev-host
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run smoke -w opik-genui && cd python && uv run --locked pytest -q
